instruction:
Use the ANSYS Fluent GUI to complete the following benchmark flow analysis:

Physical problem: lid-driven cavity flow, validating the laminar vortex-core velocity field.

Model parameters:
- Square cavity: 1 mm x 1 mm (2D)
- Fluid: water-liquid
- Mesh: structured quadrilateral mesh, element size 0.05 mm

Boundary conditions:
- Top lid: moving wall, X-velocity 0.1 m/s
- Other three walls: stationary, no-slip

Analysis type: laminar steady-state

Solver setup:
- Pressure-based, steady, laminar model
- Second-order schemes, SIMPLE algorithm
- Hybrid initialization, 1000 iterations

Save requirements:
- Case and Data files: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cavity.cas and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cavity.dat
